finalText:
Redis died at 02:14:07, `ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. Cache fell back to direct store reads. Store overloaded, 173 timeouts, queue climbed 52 to 568 past its max of 500. All 13 reconnects failed. worker-2 hit heap out of memory at 02:31:44, then supervisor killed api. Service down 02:31:52.

Root cause is Redis, not the app. Check why it refuses connections.
